title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Added RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; updated docs site sections and cross-links; no breaking changes.
description: This PR adds opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples for common integrations, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide engineers with end-to-end, copy-pasteable examples that demonstrate building a RAG agent using the Redwood API, tool calling for external data (search, vector DB, email), and deployment-ready templates for both hosted and private deployments. Changes include new quickstart guides, an examples repo subfolder with Python and TypeScript samples, template agent manifests, and multiple docs site pages with crosslinks and walkthroughs. Checklist: 1) Quickstart docs written and linked on the docs site; 2) Example code tested locally and in CI; 3) Site navigation updated; 4) Inline snippets validated for formatting; 5) Add notices for private deployment considerations. Testing summary: lint and docs-build pass, unit tests for examples pass, integration smoke test against a sandbox vector DB passed on rerun. No runtime or API surface changes are included; the work is docs/examples only.
